race.description: Sole Refrigeration & Air Conditioning F&M (Bm56) Hcp
race.comment: PLEASE ME DO (4) won here in similar company 12 days ago over 1103m and will only carry an extra kilo this time after a clever 3kg claim. She has the pole position and is up to repeating the dose. THE BIRTHDAY PARTY (8) just battled fresh up and gets the blinkers on this time. Don't sell her short second up. BLISS BOMB (3) was a beaten favourite fresh up off a freshen up and probably needed the run. She is on a 7-day backup, and can finish a lot closer, so follow your money. Each-way. HEXED (5) ended her last season on a winning note at Mildura, and she resumes with a recent jumpout under her belt. Keep her safe in all combos.
